title: Scaling signal disambiguation: reduce false-positive KEDA triggers during warm-pool handoffs
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Summary: During a capacity event on 2025-11-06 we observed a burst of spurious KEDA scale-ups that overshot target capacity and caused oscillations and elevated cost for ~90 minutes. Root cause analysis indicates probe/metric aliasing combined with warm-pool handoff semantics produced transient high-percentile spikes which KEDA interpreted as sustained demand. This ticket tracks follow-up work to disambiguate scaling signals and harden HPA+KEDA interactions.
timeline:
2025-11-06 03:12 UTC: Upstream traffic spike to hosted inference for model 'redwood-embedded-v2'
2025-11-06 03:14 UTC: Warm-pool handoff begins; new pods enter serving lifecycle and emit elevated readiness probe latencies for 12-30s while KV cache warms
2025-11-06 03:16 UTC: KEDA external scaler (redis queue length + custom latency metric) reports p95 latency > 1200ms for two sampling windows and triggers scale-up policy
2025-11-06 03:22 UTC: Autoscaler overshoots due to concurrent pod creation and short-term probe amplification; controller initiates additional replicas which enter warmup and exacerbate metric noise
2025-11-06 04:40 UTC: Stabilization after applying emergency rollback to earlier KEDA scaler config and enabling circuit-breaker on new warm-pool slot provisioning
impact_summary: Duration ~ 90 minutes. Customer-facing latencies increased intermittently; internal cost increased by ~27% for affected shard. No data loss. Estimated customer_impact: medium. Topline telemetry shows 8% error-rate bump for affected tenant subset during incident window.
root_cause:
1) KEDA external scaler used a short sampling window (30s) and single high-percentile metric (p95) as a binary trigger; transient probe amplification during pod initialization produced false-positive high-percentile readings.
2) Warm-pool handoff causes multiple pods to initialize concurrently; KV cache warm-up and readiness probe behavior amplify percentile metrics.
3) No hysteresis or smoothing in the KEDA trigger pipeline, and HPA targetCPU/targetMemory had no coupling with external scaler signals, enabling runaway replica additions.
4) Lack of a coordinated ramp-up policy across dedicated pools and lack of circuit-breaker for cold-start amplification.
action_items: (A1) Implement percentile smoothing layer in KEDA external scaler: compute rolling-window EWMA over p95 with configurable alpha and expose smoothed metric to scaler - owner: Daniel Cho - estimate: 3 - due: 2025-11-20

(A2) Introduce warm-pool-aware readiness flag: add 'warm_kv_ready' probe emitted by runtime when KV cache cold-start finishes; use this flag to suppress p95 spikes in scaler - owner: Priya Nair - estimate: 5 - due: 2025-11-24

(A3) Add scale-up rate limiter in horizontal autoscaler controller: max delta replicas per minute per pool and randomized jitter to avoid lock-step adds - owner: Miguel Alvarez - estimate: 3 - due: 2025-11-18

(A4) Update KEDA scaler config templates for Dedicated: increase sampling window to 90s and require consecutive windows (2) above threshold before scale-up - owner: SRE Team (James Liu) - estimate: 2 - due: 2025-11-16

(A5) Add end-to-end test in chaos-suite that simulates warm-pool handoff + probe noise and validates no more than one reactive scale-up within 120s - owner: Test Infra (Lena Petrova) - estimate: 3 - due: 2025-11-27

(A6) Dashboard + alerts: create a "scaling-signal-entropy" grafana panel and alert when p95/p99 divergence > 2x and scale-up rate > threshold - owner: Observability (Noah Patel) - estimate: 2 - due: 2025-11-19
(A7) Runbook update: document emergency mitigations (rollback scaler template, enable scale-up circuit-breaker) and add Slack alert playbook - owner: SRE (James Liu) - estimate: 1 - due: 2025-11-14
progress_updates: 2025-11-07: Initial RCA posted to #incidents and incident-summary doc linked. Todd (PM) requested action items and customer_impact estimate.
2025-11-08: Emergency config rollback performed that reduced oscillation; follow-up plan drafted during post-incident review (see links).

2025-11-09: Spike reproduction harness created in staging; warm-pool initialization script instrumented to emit 'kv_warm' trace events. First repro run shows p95 spike correlates with cache-miss ratio during startup.

2025-11-11: Prototype EWMA smoothing implemented in feature branch (github.com/redwood-inference/keda-proto/pull/112) and demoed in eng sync. Preliminary results: 70% reduction in false-positive triggers in synthetic test.
2025-11-12: Design review scheduled for smoothing rollout and readiness flag contract. This ticket moving to 'In Review' for cross-team signoff.
